kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteHost

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host where the host that you want to delete resides.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where the host that you want to delete resides.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host that you want to delete.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id
